content.title: 2021 ACC/AHA/SCAI Coronary Revascularization Guideline
highlights: The document contains references to various studies and guidelines related to coronary revascularization.
Key studies and trials include HELP AMI, CRISP-AMI, and British Heart Foundation RITA 3.
The guidelines cover topics related to PCI strategies, revascularization methods, and surgical myocardial revascularization.
They emphasize the importance of evidence-based strategies and the evaluation of specific clinical settings like ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction (STEMI) and acute coronary syndrome.
Specific trials and studies are cited for providing clinical insights, such as the North-Rhine-Westphalia Surgical Myocardial Infarction Registry and the BARI 2D trial.
